g.text: py-app-poster-partner-a4 | type poster | trim 210 x 297 mm, bleed 3 mm | status rebuilt
Bron: 22 printbestanden (source/print). Referentie = getrouwe vectorweergave; template = officiele tokenkleuren, 3 mm bleed, variabelen als live tekst. Labels staan in aparte groepen.
Slim parkeren. Snel in de stad.
Bron: MarketingCampagne_ParkingYouPartner.pdf p1 (RGB (ICC), mock-up slide; bleed box in bron nee). Template: trim 210 x 297 mm, bleed 3 mm, totaal 216 x 303 mm.

Variabelen: background-colour = #1A3580; price = €7; price-cents = 50; unit = per dag; headline-1 = Jouw dagje; headline-2 = shoppen; headline-3 = start hier!; subline = Slim parkeren. Snel in de stad.; footer-text = Volg de borden; location-name = Philips Stadion

A4 poster 210 x 297 mm, shown as a MOCK-UP on the slide 'Partner pakket' at a scale of 0.35807 (white sheet 75.194 x 106.346 mm on the slide, so 210.0 x 297.0 mm real, A4 is a standard format). The reference is the mock-up taken from the slide at real size (viewBox 210 x 297 mm, no bleed: the mock-up shows the trimmed sheet; the template

adds 3 mm bleed). REBUILT: all texts are outlined in the source and are live Ubuntu in the template, fitted by overlay (IoU 0.88 to 0.99): headline 'Jouw dagje' / 'shoppen' (orange) / 'start hier!' Ubuntu Bold 31.0 mm, tracking -0.02 em, line pitch 30.3 mm; 'Slim parkeren. Snel in de stad.' Ubuntu Medium 10.45 mm white; 'Volg de borden' Ubuntu
Medium 10.49 mm navy (the brief says regular and bold: the overlay fits Medium best for both); the price circle and the location pill come from the new comps.
